title: ICC Chiller Plant O&M Manual (2009 edition)

extractedFields.shutdownSequence: manual isolation valves, no BMS interlock

sourceText: ICC CHILLER PLANT O&M MANUAL (2009 EDITION). This is the original commissioning-era manual for the ICC (環球貿易廣場) central chiller plant. Equipment: four York YK centrifugal chillers. SHUTDOWN PROCEDURE (2009): operators manually close the chilled-water isolation valves in sequence, then trip the chiller breaker locally. There is no BMS interlock in this edition; coordination is by radio with the control room. NOTE: This 2009 edition is SUPERSEDED by the 2023 edition after the BMS retrofit. Use only for historical reference.

title: ICC Chiller Plant O&M Manual (2016 revision)

extractedFields.equipment: York YK centrifugal chillers x4 (VSD retrofit)
extractedFields.shutdownSequence: BMS-assisted soft stop then valve isolation

sourceText: ICC CHILLER PLANT O&M MANUAL (2016 REVISION). Following the variable-speed-drive (VSD) retrofit, the shutdown procedure changed. SHUTDOWN PROCEDURE (2016): initiate a BMS-assisted soft stop, allow the chiller to ramp down, then close the chilled-water isolation valves. This edition is SUPERSEDED by the 2023 edition. Equipment: four York YK chillers with VSD retrofit.
chunkText: ICC chiller plant O&M, 2016 revision (post-VSD retrofit). SHUTDOWN: initiate BMS-assisted soft stop, let the chiller ramp down, then close chilled-water isolation valves. SUPERSEDED by the 2023 edition. Equipment: four York YK chillers with VSD.

title: ICC Chiller Plant O&M Manual (2023 current edition)

extractedFields.equipment: York YK chillers x4 + 2 magnetic-bearing chillers
extractedFields.shutdownSequence: BMS sequenced soft stop with automatic valve interlock

sourceText: ICC CHILLER PLANT O&M MANUAL (2023 CURRENT EDITION). This is the AUTHORITATIVE current procedure for the ICC (環球貿易廣場) central chiller plant. SHUTDOWN PROCEDURE (2023): from the BMS, select 'Plant Sequenced Shutdown'. The BMS performs a sequenced soft stop of each chiller and automatically drives the chilled-water isolation valves closed via interlock. Confirm zero flow on the BMS mimic before isolating power. Two magnetic-bearing chillers were added in 2022. This is the CURRENT, non-obsolete edition — always use this for live operations.
chunkText: ICC (環球貿易廣場) chiller plant O&M — 2023 CURRENT edition (authoritative). SHUTDOWN: from the BMS select 'Plant Sequenced Shutdown'; BMS soft-stops each chiller and auto-closes the chilled-water isolation valves via interlock; confirm zero flow on the BMS mimic before isolating power. Equipment now includes two magnetic-bearing chillers (added 2022). Current, non-obsolete edition.

title: 師傅 Frontline Guide — Trapped-Passenger Lift Rescue

extractedFields.keyStep: manual brake release + hand-winding (盤車) to nearest landing

sourceText: FRONTLINE TECHNICIAN (師傅) GUIDE — TRAPPED-PASSENGER LIFT RESCUE. This guide digitalizes know-how previously held only in experienced 師傅's heads. STEPS for a 困人 (trapped passenger) event: 1) Reassure passengers via intercom; confirm the car position. 2) Switch the lift to inspection/maintenance. 3) Apply the manual brake release and use hand-winding (盤車) to move the car to the nearest landing. 4) Level the car, open the doors, release passengers. 5) Lock out the lift and log the incident. SAFETY: two technicians minimum; never hand-wind against a moving counterweight without confirming brake control.
chunkText: 師傅 frontline guide — 困人 (trapped passenger) lift rescue. Safety: two 師傅 minimum; confirm brake control before hand-winding. Digitalizes in-head technician know-how.
